edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 19 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 依据11月19日邮件七则 Top Stories，按原顺序原创改写，含21道单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The three leaders held unprecedented trilateral talks in Shenzhen.
items.cloze: The three leaders held ______ trilateral talks in Shenzhen.
items.analysis_zh: unprecedented trilateral talks 由形容词修饰三边会谈，强调这种会谈此前没有先例。它描述会议形式，未对外交成果作出评价；historic 往往暗含重大历史意义，语气更强。
items.why_zh: 突出首次三边会谈这一事实。

imitation.background_zh: 假设三家合作商首次开会
imitation.sentence_en: The partners held an unprecedented joint meeting.
imitation.translation_zh: 合作伙伴举行了一场史无前例的联合会议。

context.zh: 举行了史无前例的三方会谈

items.example: Xi characterised the discussion as groundbreaking, but no detailed agreement was disclosed.
items.cloze: Xi characterised the discussion as ______, but no detailed agreement was disclosed.
items.analysis_zh: characterised the discussion as groundbreaking 使用 characterise A as B 结构，groundbreaking 是讲话者对讨论的评价。but 后面说明协议细节尚未披露，不能将这一评价当作已证实的谈判成果。
items.why_zh: 保留评价归因及协议尚未披露的限制。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目负责人评价新流程
imitation.sentence_en: The manager described the new process as groundbreaking.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理称新流程具有开创性。

context.zh: 称这次讨论具有开创性

items.example: Trump subsequently said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end.
items.cloze: Trump ______ said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end.
items.analysis_zh: subsequently said 中副词修饰过去时动词 said，说明外交会晤后的发言顺序。subsequently 只表示时间先后；therefore 表示因果，两者不可混淆，避免暗示会谈直接促成这一表态。
items.why_zh: 准确表示会谈之后的时间顺序。

imitation.sentence_en: The teams negotiated prices and subsequently agreed on delivery terms.
imitation.translation_zh: 双方谈妥价格，随后就交货条款达成一致。

context.en: Trump subsequently said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end
context.zh: 特朗普随后表示，美中两国政府都希望乌克兰战争结束

items.example: Anthropic's public offering eclipsed previous listing records by raising $81bn.
items.cloze: Anthropic's public offering ______ previous listing records by raising $81bn.
items.analysis_zh: eclipsed previous listing records 使用 eclipse + 宾语表示新纪录盖过旧纪录，过去时说明融资已经完成。surpassed 和 exceeded 也表示超过；eclipsed 更强调旧纪录因此显得逊色。
items.why_zh: 突出了融资规模刷新上市纪录。

imitation.sentence_en: The new product eclipsed the previous sales record.
imitation.translation_zh: 新产品打破并超越了此前的销售纪录。

context.zh: 打破了以往的上市纪录

items.example: The offer price implied a valuation of roughly $1.5trn.
items.cloze: The offer price ______ a valuation of roughly $1.5trn.
items.analysis_zh: implied a valuation of roughly $1.5trn 表示发行价对应的推算估值；roughly 保留估算性质。implied valuation 是金融分析术语，不能将估值与企业实际收到的融资金额混为一谈。
items.why_zh: 准确区分发行价格对应的估值和融资额。

imitation.sentence_en: The revised bid implied a higher company valuation.
imitation.translation_zh: 修订后的报价意味着更高的企业估值。

context.zh: 对应的估值约为1.5万亿美元

items.example: The successful flotation offered some relief after a sell-off in technology shares.
items.cloze: The successful flotation offered some ______ after a sell-off in technology shares.
items.analysis_zh: offered some relief 中 relief 为不可数名词，some 限定改善程度。sell-off 指集中抛售；relief 只表示压力有所缓解，不能等同于 recovery 所暗示的市场全面恢复。
items.why_zh: 审慎描述科技股下跌后的短暂情绪改善。

imitation.sentence_en: The delivery brought some relief to the production team.
imitation.translation_zh: 这次交货让生产团队稍感宽慰。

context.en: offered some relief after a sell-off in technology shares
context.zh: 在科技股遭到抛售之后，让市场稍稍松了一口气

items.example: Washington and Caracas agreed to restore military ties.
items.cloze: Washington and Caracas agreed to ______ military ties.
items.analysis_zh: restore military ties 是 restore + 名词宾语，强调双方恢复原先存在的军事联系。与 establish military ties 表示首次建立关系不同，restore 包含关系曾经中断或削弱的背景。
items.why_zh: 明确双方恢复已有联系的事实。

imitation.sentence_en: The partners agreed to restore their monthly meetings.
imitation.translation_zh: 合作伙伴同意恢复每月例会。

context.zh: 恢复军事关系

items.example: The agreement envisages joint exercises and intelligence sharing.
items.cloze: The agreement ______ joint exercises and intelligence sharing.
items.analysis_zh: agreement envisages joint exercises 是 envisage + 名词短语，说明协议拟安排的合作内容。envisage 不保证相关活动已经开展；completed 或 conducted 才可描述已经执行的行动。
items.why_zh: 准确区分协议计划与已经执行的活动。

imitation.sentence_en: The expansion plan envisages a second production line.
imitation.translation_zh: 扩产方案设想增加第二条生产线。

context.en: envisages joint exercises and intelligence sharing
context.zh: 设想开展联合演习并共享情报

items.example: The defence chief's visit occurred amid a wider political realignment.
items.cloze: The defence chief's visit occurred amid a wider political ______.
items.analysis_zh: political realignment 是名词短语，指政治力量及关系格局的调整；amid 引出访问发生时的背景。realignment 与 reconciliation 有区别，后者强调和解，报道未能证明各方已经全面和解。
items.why_zh: 概括政治关系变化并避免推断全面和解。

imitation.sentence_en: The restructuring prompted a realignment of responsibilities.
imitation.translation_zh: 重组促使职责重新调整。

context.zh: 范围更广的政治格局调整

items.example: The agency said reducing reliance on the Strait of Hormuz would require major spending.
items.cloze: The agency said reducing ______ on the Strait of Hormuz would require major spending.
items.analysis_zh: reducing reliance on 使用 reliance on 的固定介词搭配，指对霍尔木兹海峡运输通道的依赖。would require 是条件性预测，说明降低依赖需要投入，不能写成投资已实际完成。
items.why_zh: 强调降低对运输通道依赖的条件。

imitation.sentence_en: The factory aims to reduce reliance on one supplier.
imitation.translation_zh: 工厂希望减少对单一供应商的依赖。

context.en: reducing reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
context.zh: 降低对霍尔木兹海峡的依赖

items.example: Its outlook estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields.
items.cloze: Its ______ estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields.
items.analysis_zh: Its outlook 指国际能源署的能源展望报告，名词作主语。outlook 在此是预测性出版物，不能理解为市场乐观情绪；estimated 后的金额属于机构估算，并非已发生的投资。
items.why_zh: 准确标注金额来自机构展望报告的估算。

imitation.sentence_en: The annual outlook predicts slower demand growth.
imitation.translation_zh: 年度展望报告预测需求增长放缓。

context.en: Its outlook estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields
context.zh: 该机构在展望报告中估算，管道需要投入400亿美元，油田需要投入2000亿美元

items.example: Conflict in Iran could accelerate efforts to develop domestic energy.
items.cloze: Conflict in Iran could ______ efforts to develop domestic energy.
items.analysis_zh: could accelerate efforts to develop 使用 could + 动词原形表达可能性；accelerate efforts to do sth 表示加快推进某项工作。与 trigger 表示触发行动不同，accelerate 强调速度提高。
items.why_zh: 保留可能性并准确描述政策反应。

imitation.sentence_en: A shortage could accelerate efforts to source materials locally.
imitation.translation_zh: 短缺可能加快本地采购材料的工作。

context.en: accelerate efforts to develop domestic energy
context.zh: 加快开发本国能源的步伐

items.example: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire boundary known as the yellow line.
items.cloze: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire ______ known as the yellow line.
items.analysis_zh: crossed the ceasefire boundary 中 cross 直接接宾语，无需再加 over。boundary 指停火安排划定的分界线；border 通常用于国家边境，因此 boundary 更贴合此处协议控制线。
items.why_zh: 描述坦克越过停火分界线的行动。

imitation.sentence_en: Vehicles must not cross the marked safety boundary.
imitation.translation_zh: 车辆不得越过标记的安全界线。

context.zh: 越过停火分界线

items.example: The military described its incursion as limited and aimed at removing threats.
items.cloze: The military described its ______ as limited and aimed at removing threats.
items.analysis_zh: described its incursion as limited 使用 describe A as B，明确 limited 是以军对行动规模的自我描述。incursion 指进入他方控制区域的行动，通常比 invasion 范围小；规模仍需独立核实。
items.why_zh: 保留行动性质及其有限规模的消息归因。

imitation.sentence_en: The exercise simulated an incursion into a secure network.
imitation.translation_zh: 演练模拟了对安全网络的侵入。

context.zh: 称此次越界军事行动规模有限

items.example: Israel separately reported air strikes that it said killed two commanders.
items.cloze: Israel separately ______ air strikes that it said killed two commanders.
items.analysis_zh: Israel reported air strikes that it said killed 使用 reported 和 it said 双重归因，限定袭击和伤亡信息来自以方。涉及冲突中的死亡数字，不能省略来源限定改写为独立核实的事实。
items.why_zh: 冲突伤亡信息需要明确来源。

imitation.sentence_en: The supplier reported that it had completed corrective actions.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商报告称已完成纠正措施。

context.zh: 通报了空袭行动

items.example: Grand Theft Auto VI made its long-awaited debut to enthusiastic reviews.
items.cloze: Grand Theft Auto VI made its long-awaited ______ to enthusiastic reviews.
items.analysis_zh: made its long-awaited debut 是 make one's debut 固定搭配，debut 为名词，表示作品正式推出。launch 可作名词或动词，但不能直接替换这里的 debut 而保持 make its 结构自然。
items.why_zh: 使用固定搭配描述作品正式上市。

imitation.sentence_en: The new analyser made its debut at the exhibition.
imitation.translation_zh: 新分析仪在展会上首次亮相。

context.zh: 在外界期盼已久后首次亮相

items.example: The publisher's shares rose as investors welcomed the game's reception.
items.cloze: The publisher's shares rose as investors welcomed the game's ______.
items.analysis_zh: the game's reception 指作品获得的评价和受众反响，区别于 sales 的实际销售额。as 说明股价上涨时伴随的市场反应，不能据此断言好评是唯一涨价原因。
items.why_zh: 区分评论反响和实际销量。

imitation.sentence_en: The positive reception encouraged the speaker.
imitation.translation_zh: 积极的反响鼓舞了演讲者。

context.zh: 对游戏上市后获得的反响感到欣喜

items.example: Analysts projected first-week revenue above $3bn, although the number remained a forecast.
items.cloze: Analysts ______ first-week revenue above $3bn, although the number remained a forecast.
items.analysis_zh: analysts projected first-week revenue 使用分析师作主语的过去时预测表达。although 后明确该数字仍属预测；projected revenue 与 reported revenue 不同，后者指已披露的实际收入。
items.why_zh: 避免将分析师预测误写成已实现收入。

imitation.sentence_en: Analysts projected stronger sales next quarter.
imitation.translation_zh: 分析师预测下季度销售额更高。

context.zh: 预测首周收入将超过30亿美元

items.example: A Van Gogh painting fetched more than $190m at Sotheby's.
items.cloze: A Van Gogh painting ______ more than $190m at Sotheby's.
items.analysis_zh: fetched more than $190m 是艺术品拍卖报道常用结构，fetch + 金额表示实际成交价格。与 was valued at 指估值不同，fetched 描述已经发生的交易，过去时对应拍卖完成。
items.why_zh: 突出实际成交价而非估价。

imitation.sentence_en: The photograph fetched a record price at auction.
imitation.translation_zh: 这张照片在拍卖会上拍出创纪录的价格。

context.zh: 在苏富比拍出了逾1.9亿美元的价格

items.example: A short bidding contest drove the price beyond the artist's previous record.
items.cloze: A short ______ contest drove the price beyond the artist's previous record.
items.analysis_zh: bidding contest 中 bidding 作名词定语，指拍卖中的买家竞价。drove the price beyond 描述竞争推动成交价突破纪录；这里的 bidding 与采购招投标 tender bidding 所指场景不同。
items.why_zh: 准确描述竞价推动价格突破纪录。

imitation.sentence_en: Competitive bidding drove up the price of the jersey.
imitation.translation_zh: 激烈竞价推高了球衣的价格。

context.zh: 一轮短暂的竞价

items.example: The auction house had earlier reached a settlement with the seller's heirs.
items.cloze: The auction house had earlier reached a ______ with the seller's heirs.
items.analysis_zh: reached a settlement with sb 是法律语境固定搭配，指与某方达成和解。had earlier reached 用过去完成时说明和解先于拍卖；settlement 不代表法院已经认定此前出售存在违法行为。
items.why_zh: 区分此前和解与本次成交，避免推断法律责任。

imitation.sentence_en: The companies reached a settlement after negotiations.
imitation.translation_zh: 两家公司谈判后达成和解。

context.en: reached a settlement with the seller's heirs
context.zh: 与卖方继承人达成和解

passages.title: Three leaders meet in Shenzhen
passages.body: The three leaders held {{2026-11-19-summit-unprecedented}} trilateral talks in Shenzhen. Xi characterised the discussion as {{2026-11-19-summit-groundbreaking}}, but no detailed agreement was disclosed. Trump {{2026-11-19-summit-subsequently}} said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end. Trump had also met the other leaders separately before the three-way discussion.

passages.title: Anthropic's enormous stock-market debut
passages.body: Anthropic's public offering {{2026-11-19-anthropic-eclipsed}} previous listing records by raising $81bn. The offer price {{2026-11-19-anthropic-implied}} a valuation of roughly $1.5trn. The successful flotation offered some {{2026-11-19-anthropic-relief}} after a sell-off in technology shares. The strong demand for the shares contrasted with the sector's recent weakness.

passages.title: Washington and Caracas discuss defence cooperation
passages.body: Washington and Caracas agreed to {{2026-11-19-venezuela-restore}} military ties. The agreement {{2026-11-19-venezuela-envisages}} joint exercises and intelligence sharing. The defence chief's visit occurred amid a wider political {{2026-11-19-venezuela-realignment}}. The American official met Venezuela's acting president during the visit.

passages.title: IEA calculates the cost of energy security
passages.body: The agency said reducing {{2026-11-19-energy-reliance}} on the Strait of Hormuz would require major spending. Its {{2026-11-19-energy-outlook}} estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields. Conflict in Iran could {{2026-11-19-energy-accelerate}} efforts to develop domestic energy. The figures reflect the agency's estimates rather than completed investments.

passages.title: Israeli tanks enter Gaza’s ceasefire zone
passages.body: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire {{2026-11-19-gaza-boundary}} known as the yellow line. The military described its {{2026-11-19-gaza-incursion}} as limited and aimed at removing threats. Israel separately {{2026-11-19-gaza-reported}} air strikes that it said killed two commanders. The developments renewed concerns about the durability of the ceasefire.

passages.title: Grand Theft Auto VI arrives to acclaim
passages.body: Grand Theft Auto VI made its long-awaited {{2026-11-19-gta-debut}} to enthusiastic reviews. The publisher's shares rose as investors welcomed the game's {{2026-11-19-gta-reception}}. Analysts {{2026-11-19-gta-projected}} first-week revenue above $3bn, although the number remained a forecast. The launch also lifted shares in the company behind the game by around 6%.

passages.title: Van Gogh painting achieves record auction price
passages.body: A Van Gogh painting {{2026-11-19-vangogh-fetched}} more than $190m at Sotheby's. A short {{2026-11-19-vangogh-bidding}} contest drove the price beyond the artist's previous record. The auction house had earlier reached a {{2026-11-19-vangogh-settlement}} with the seller's heirs. The heirs argued that the painting had been sold under financial pressure in 1936.
